create_Visualizer: create a Visualizer instance with experiment options to connect to a visdom server and set up HTML logging
save_images: save a dictionary of labeled images to disk and embed them into an HTML webpage
save_videos: save a dictionary of labeled video tensors as webm files and embed them into an HTML webpage
display_current_results: display current training results on visdom and optionally save them to an HTML file by epoch
plot_current_losses: plot training loss curves over epochs on a visdom line chart with labeled legends
